MSC Industrial Supply is a large distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products and services. The company provides over 2 million industrial items—including cutting tools, measuring instruments, fasteners, and safety supplies—along with inventory management and supply chain solutions to manufacturing companies and workshops. [](https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/msc-industrial-direct-co-inc/)

- **Metalworking supplies:** Cutting tools, toolholding, abrasives, and raw materials.

- **MRO items:** Plumbing, electrical supplies, power transmission, and hand tools.

- **Safety and PPE:** Personal protective equipment, janitorial products, and security items

[](https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/msc-industrial-direct-co-inc/)

### Services and Solutions

- **Inventory management:** Vendor-managed inventory and automated supply vending machines placed directly in client facilities.

- **Technical support:** On-site engineering and application support to help optimize manufacturing processes.

- **Fulfillment:** Fast delivery services through regional fulfillment centers and warehouses. [](https://www.mscdirect.co.uk/services)
